versions.description: Collection of functions that are executed when a player joins the server. Helps with onboarding new players, like sending a welcome message. The starter kit is an Item Set, managed on the server's Item Sets page.
versions.configSchema: {"$schema":"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#","type":"object","properties":{"message":{"title":"Message","description":"The message to send to the player when they join the server.","type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":256,"default":"Welcome {player} to the server!"},"starterKitItemSet":{"type":"string","title":"Starter kit item set","description":"The item set a player receives when they run the starterkit command for the first time on this server.","x-component":"itemSet"}},"required":[],"additionalProperties":false}

commands.name: starterkit
commands.helpText: Get a starter kit, you can only execute this once on a server!

hooks.name: playerConnected
